description: This file defines an interface `ILogConsistencyProtocolServices` for log consistency protocols, along with a custom exception class `ProtocolTransportException`. The interface includes methods for copying data, retrieving cluster and grain identifiers, logging errors/exceptions, and general logging. The file is part of the Orleans project and focuses on communication and error handling within log consistency protocols.

classes.name: ProtocolTransportException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating errors in protocol messaging layers, serializable and derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: ProtocolError
methods.description: Logs an error message related to the log-consistency protocol.

methods.name: CaughtException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught during protocol execution.

methods.name: CaughtUserCodeException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught in user code callback.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Outputs a message at the specified log level.
